# Requirements Quality Checklist: Optional HTML Cleaner

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, clarity, completeness, and testability of the requirements for the Optional HTML Cleaner feature before task breakdown and implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [cleaner-api.md](../contracts/cleaner-api.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

---

## 1. API & Configuration Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Is the default state of `clean_html` in `FoxcapeConfig` explicitly documented as `False`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Contract §3.1]
- [x] CHK002 - Are call-level override semantics (`None` vs `True` vs `False`) clearly specified for all synchronous and asynchronous entry points? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-013, Plan §Data Model]
- [x] CHK003 - Is the signature and return behavior of the standalone `clean_html()` utility documented in public surface contracts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, Contract §1]
- [x] CHK004 - Are requirements unambiguous regarding byte-identical output when `clean_html` is disabled? [Consistency, Spec §SC-001, User Story 2]

---

## 2. Ad, Widget & CMP Removal Clarity

- [x] CHK005 - Are Google AdSense component fingerprints (classes, IDs, attributes) explicitly enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Research §2]
- [x] CHK006 - Are script and iframe network URL patterns for advertising explicitly defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK007 - Are recommendation widget signatures (Outbrain, Taboola, RevContent) documented with exact selector/script markers? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007, §FR-008]
- [x] CHK008 - Are CMP/consent banner markers (OneTrust, Cookiebot, Quantcast, generic cookie/GDPR) clearly categorized? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK009 - Is subtree removal behavior (removing container + all descendants) explicitly documented? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]

---

## 3. Overlay Heuristic & Content Preservation

- [x] CHK010 - Are the multi-criteria conditions required for overlay removal explicitly defined without ambiguity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK011 - Does the spec explicitly prohibit element removal based on a single heuristic or class name alone? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, §FR-011]
- [x] CHK012 - Are measurable criteria specified for what constitutes large viewport coverage in static DOM? [Measurability, Spec §Assumptions, Research §2]
- [x] CHK013 - Are content preservation guarantees defined when legitimate article text appears near or inside modal structures? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011, User Story 3]

---

## 4. Edge Cases & Robustness

- [x] CHK014 - Is fallback behavior clearly defined when parsing encounters malformed or invalid HTML markup? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK015 - Are requirements specified for handling nested removable elements (e.g., ad iframe inside consent banner)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK016 - Is behavior defined for pages that contain zero removable elements (no false positives)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, User Story 1]
- [x] CHK017 - Is the handling of empty leftover wrapper containers explicitly bounded in scope? [Scope Boundary, Spec §Assumptions]

---

## 5. Non-Functional & Architectural Consistency

- [x] CHK018 - Does the specification forbid introduction of new third-party runtime dependencies? [Constraint, Spec §FR-014, Constitution §I]
- [x] CHK019 - Are all cleaning validation tests specified to execute 100% offline without browser launch or network access? [Traceability, Spec §SC-004, Constitution §II]
- [x] CHK020 - Does the spec explicitly exclude ML models, LLM classification, and browser request interception? [Constraint, Spec §FR-015, Constitution §IV]
- [x] CHK021 - Is the rules catalog decoupled from the cleaning engine in the architectural specification? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, Plan §Summary]

---

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Items are numbered sequentially (CHK001 - CHK021) for unambiguous reference.
